notice: SYNTHETIC discovery-mechanics cases (placeholder ids), registered with docs/sprint-10a/PREREGISTRATION.md before implementation. Each case names one deterministic expectation; backend/tests/discovery-intelligence.test.ts implements them by id. Nothing in the runtime reads this file. Changes are appended as amendments; earlier entries are kept.

cases.expect: a tag on the brand's own profile never enters the frontier pool
a pool concept whose tag namespace is absent from the brand's profile is OUTSIDE_BRAND_PROFILE_FACETS
a pool concept whose namespace the brand's profile carries is WITHIN_BRAND_PROFILE_FACETS
a free media keyword with higher support is ordered after taxonomy concepts with support >= 2
the best-supported taxonomy concept is the first pool entry
taxonomy concepts from two namespaces alternate (round-robin by namespace)
the pool is identical when the evidence-base profiles arrive in another order
concepts cut by the pool size are recorded as deferred with a reason
a support-1 taxonomy concept is not ordered above a support-2 taxonomy concept
no related profiles and no seed profiles give an empty pool
an agent hypothesis with motivatedBy ids observed in the run is accepted and keeps them
an agent hypothesis citing an id never observed in the run is refused
more than 6 motivatedBy ids are refused by the tool schema
a hypothesis whose probes returned no members ends NOT_SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED
a hypothesis with brand-independent members and a PARTIAL route is QLOO_SUPPORTED, never RELATIVELY_MEASURED
a FULL route with a numeric position is RELATIVELY_MEASURED
a FULL route whose position is null is QLOO_SUPPORTED
a dropped duplicate ends NOT_SUPPORTED / DUPLICATE
an incidental venue attribute ends NOT_SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE after members were observed ends NOT_SUPPORTED / UNMEASURABLE
a candidate dropped for budget ends NOT_SUPPORTED / INCONCLUSIVE
seeds are the scan's retained entity observations with their own correlation id; brand-profile tags are not seeds
excluded or type-conflicting entities never become seeds
a seed from a partial or degraded response is flagged partial
a signal whose correlation id is not in the scan's provenance is not a seed
the explore handoff refuses a scan that is not complete
the explore handoff builds explore_frontier with no named territory, and no seed name or id in the query text
seeds reach the model only while explore_candidate_territories is active, bounded to 12
a seed is never Qloo support: qlooSupport is unchanged by seeds
at most 3 seed entities are profiled; the 4th profile is refused
a tag from a profiled seed enters the pool with the seed named as its supporting entity
the deterministic baseline result is unchanged and makes no extra call
the explore skill's tool allowlist is unchanged
a failed seed profile is not evidence: no pool entry, the seed stays unprofiled
